title: Aviso n.º 6/GBM/2025, Directrizes de Gestão dos Riscos Climáticos (Climate Risk Management Guidelines)
citation: Banco de Moçambique Aviso n.º 6/GBM/2025 de 21 de Outubro, Boletim da República I Série n.º 201, pp. 1451-1452 (issued under Lei n.º 20/2020 Art. 90 n.º 2)
evidence: Aviso n.º 6/GBM/2025 n.º 3: "O presente Aviso entra em vigor 180 dias após a data da sua publicação." The gazette issue is dated "Terça-feira, 21 de Outubro de 2025" (I SÉRIE, Número 201). 2025-10-21 plus 180 days is 2026-04-19; the date is computed, no official page prints it. Opened the PDF on 2026-11-03.
notes: Credit institutions, financial companies and other institutions supervised by the Banco de Moçambique must integrate physical and transition climate risk into risk management (Arts. 3 to 13) and disclose governance, strategy, risk management and metrics in their market-discipline reports (Arts. 14 and 15, a TCFD-shaped list). Breach is a contravenção under Lei n.º 20/2020. The in_force date is computed from the 180-day clause (counting convention not stated in the text; the day after is possible) and is flagged for Varun's decision. The PDF is the whole Boletim issue (it also holds Aviso n.º 5 and n.º 7/GBM/2025, not in scope); the record is the Aviso only, cut from the PDF with pdftotext -layout on each of the two columns of pages 2 to 6, because the gazette is set in two columns and whole-page extraction interleaves them. Languages stored on 2026-11-03: pt. No government English translation found: looked for on the Banco de Moçambique English normatives page (https://www.bancomoc.mz/en/the-bank/normatives/, which links the same Portuguese PDFs) on 2026-11-03.

title: Lei n.º 20/97 de 1 de Outubro, Lei do Ambiente (Environment Act)

notes: Link only: the Imprensa Nacional site refused the cloud address on 2026-11-03 (row MZ-IMPRENSANAC-ADOPTED is permission requested), so the text, its commencement clause and the page address were not read; official_url is the publisher's front page, not a page for this act. title: Decreto n.º 23/2018 de 3 de Maio, Regulamento para a Implementação de Projectos de Redução de Emissões por Desmatamento e Degradação Florestal, Conservação e Aumento de Reservas de Carbono (REDD+ Regulation)
citation: Decreto n.º 23/2018 de 3 de Maio, Boletim da República I Série n.º 87 (approved by the Council of Ministers on 2018-04-10)
notes: Link only: the Imprensa Nacional site refused the cloud address on 2026-11-03, so no commencement clause was read; a UNEP LEAP summary says it takes effect on the day of publication, which is not an official page, so in_force stays null. The decree regulates REDD+ projects and is the enacted carbon instrument; the general Regulamento dos Mercados de Carbono is still a proposal (see register.csv, F7). A 2024 ministry presentation said the decree was still in force; whether a revised version has replaced it is unchecked. No government English translation found on an official page.
